title: KestrelCare as Secondary Coverage: Share of the Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Clause.** Because a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan reimburses rental on a repair the Kestrel limited warranty also decided only as secondary coverage, the plan's share of the rental follows how much of the repair estimate the limited warranty decision covered:

- where it covered at least half of the estimate, the plan pays the major-secondary share of 75 percent;
- where it covered some of the estimate but less than half, the plan pays the minor-secondary share of 90 percent;
- where it covered nothing, the plan pays the whole reimbursement.

The covered amount and the repair estimate are those on the holder's latest limited warranty decision, booked against the vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order. The share is applied last, to the reimbursement as otherwise figured, and the result is rounded to the cent.

| Covered amount compared with the estimate | Share the plan pays |
|---|---|
| half or more | 75 percent |
| above 0.00 but below half | 90 percent |
| 0.00 | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* on an estimate of 3000.00, a covered amount of 1500.00 is exactly half, so the plan pays 75 percent; 1499.99 means 90 percent; nothing covered means 100 percent. A reimbursement of 216.60 at 75 percent is 162.45.
